description: This Java class 'DefaultMonitoringLoggerConfig' implements the 'MonitoringLoggerConfig' interface, providing configuration parameters for monitoring logger settings such as capacities, log size, and durations. It includes methods for instantiation from a config object, equality checks, and string representation.
